issues.problem: Variable 'when' had only 5 values (rule requires 6 to 12).
issues.action: Added 年末[ねんまつ] / 'at the end of the year'; all 288 combinations read correctly with なら as the only answer.

issues.problem: Distractor まで gives a grammatical sentence ('saved until buying a car'), but the meaning changes so the English 'to buy' no longer fits, which the rules allow. のに/ので/から were rejected as replacements: purpose のに is acceptable here, and ので/から leave the English almost the same.
